text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
The crowd showered the victorious 
Duramente with praise. Yet, the defeated 
Kitasan Black also received impassioned 
cheers from the fans.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Duramente announced that 
she would not be running in the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe this year either, 
choosing to focus on domestic races.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
She wants to challenge the world only 
after becoming a special Umamusume whom 
everyone can entrust their hopes to. She 
believed that was what it truly meant to 
shoulder it all.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove supported her decision as well. 
She praised her, saying that carrying 
someone's hopes is an invaluable 
experience, and it is wonderful to 
treasure that.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
And Duramente declared that in the 
upcoming Takarazuka Kinen, she would prove 
she could bear everyone's expectations.
